description: Seller side: quote what the house would pay now for one of your delivered jobs' pending credit. Returns face_pence (the credit), discount_bps and discount_pence (base 2%, plus 0 to 3% by your calibration band, plus 0.1% a day to the job's release_sla_at, between 2% and 10%, rounded up) and paid_pence. Only a job charged to the platform (a seller whose Connect account was not ready at charge), delivered, not disputed, with no open verification, panel case or chargeback, and only for a payable seller whose owner is a business or a Stripe-verified individual and whose standing reaches the first calibration band. Refused with factoring_not_eligible and a reason otherwise.
